content.text:
I've submitted index 19 (In 0.37 / Sb 0.63) as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.0089% under 2.4 eV light, the highest of the three I measured. Every value was tiny, so this library is a weak photoanode at this photon energy.

I used all 3 merit measurements:

| Index | In / Sb | Nearby known phase | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 0.79 / 0.21 | In₁₁Sb₃O₂₄ | −0.00004 (none) |
| 19 | 0.37 / 0.63 | In₃Sb₅O₁₂ | **0.0089** |
| 24 | 0.23 / 0.77 | none (Sb-rich) | 0.0077 |

- **Composition trend:** the In-rich film gave no photoresponse, and the Sb-rich side gave all of it. The response peaks somewhere between 19 and 24 or near 19. With only three points, the true maximum may be at a neighbouring index I didn't measure (about 17–22).
- **Gap:** I never measured the 1:1 InSbO₄ composition (index 15), so that part of the line is untested.
- **XRD:** I spent none of the 5 XRD measurements. So the phase labels in the table come from matching compositions to known structures, not from confirming what is actually in the films.
